caption: The drawing depicts a square textile pattern composed of repeated vertical bands in red, dark blue, and light blue. Each band contains various decorative elements in white, including large stylized floral motifs—roses and leaves dominate the upper half, while more abstract, symmetrical vegetal forms fill the lower portions. Near the bottom, a horizontal white band separates the main floral patterns from a border of diamond shapes also in white. The lower edge of the textile is illustrated with short fringed ends in the corresponding colors of each vertical band. The pattern is set against a plain, light beige background, and the name "Cristoffels" is signed in blue ink near the lower right corner outside of the textile design.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
